about: Pronunciation of invented words and names, applied before text is sent to the speech model. Phonemes use misaki's American English set (the G2P behind Kokoro): A = 'ay' as in day, O = 'oh' as in go, I = 'eye', W = 'ow' as in now, T = flapped t, ˈ = primary stress. Entries with override: true are forced with misaki's [word](/phonemes/) syntax; the rest are listed with what the default G2P already produces, so a future model change can be checked against them. Nothing here comes from the author; every entry is unreviewed until someone signs off.
